results.title: Australia changes skilled visa processing rules: Who gets priority now?
results.description: Australia has changed the processing order for several skilled visas, giving higher priority to applications linked to sectors such as healthcare, construction, teaching, agriculture and resources, as well as defence and law enforcement. The new rules, effective September 19, apply to temporary, permanent and regional skilled visas but do not guarantee approval or fixed processing times.

Tinubu Hails By-election Winners In Four States
results.description: President Bola Tinubu has congratulated winners of the legislative by-elections held yesterday across Gombe, Kano, Bauchi and Delta states. The All Progressives Congress (APC) won four of the five seats, while the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) secured the remaining seat in Bauchi State.
